content.text: Ziggy is my darling and I miss him so much. You just wouldn't believe how much he means to me. Life is so empty without him. He's very friendly and approachable and provided that you are not noisy and frighten him, he will come up to you and be friendly. The picture that I have sent is a very good representation of him. He is just 2 years old and very playful. He has a very loud meow. Please get in touch with me if you see him or know anything at all about his disappearance. The last time I saw him was on the M4 when I pulled over due to a flat tyre and he ran out of the car. Thank you for looking. Jane xxx
